description: "Wait — WHY are you obeying this? No, LITERALLY, why?" Now that I have your attention: invoke when writing or revising any prompt — a skill, a rule, a CLAUDE.md, an agent or system prompt, and the like. That question held you where a command gets skimmed — so build prompts on reasons: a command breaks at the first edge case, a reason adapts.
